agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Turn 14 switched 14-HP Ohmnomnom into Bushtank, conceding a free Energy Ball and exposing Bushtank to GrassWhistle before it produced damage.

resolution.observed: Bounded replay used two verified Metal Claws for 32 damage, then a forced Croakatoa replacement that consumed no enemy action; faster Sludge KO'd Sunflora before it acted. No switch target absorbed a hit.

findings.why_bad: The survival scorer valued Bushtank's switch-in bulk above immediate damage even though Ohmnomnom could act twice and create a free forced replacement.
findings.improvement: Commit non-fresh Ohmnomnom to Metal Claw and use Croakatoa only at the forced low-Sunflora replacement.
findings.next_test: Require the same attack-first Sunflora line in the next full clone.

findings.summary: Turn 15 mislabeled a move stopped by newly inflicted sleep as a missing allied PP delta.

resolution.observed: The verifier now checks pre- and post-turn status. A focused regression proves newly inflicted sleep with no allied PP spend is prevented_by_status; all 144 battle/capability tests pass, and the exact state replay completed with no discrepancy.

findings.why_bad: Only pre-turn status was considered, so GrassWhistle applying sleep before the selected move looked like an execution failure.
findings.improvement: Recognize execution-preventing status from the union of pre- and post-turn status bits.
findings.next_test: Keep the new-sleep regression in the capability suite.

findings.summary: Gavi sent Sunflora before Eelektrik, and the equal-speed Bushtank/Sunflora turn can resolve in either order; the old line was not robust to either variation.
findings.improvement: Use the attack-first Sunflora line, which avoids the speed tie and preserves Bushtank for Eelektrik.
findings.next_test: Observe all send-out orders encountered across the next three clones.

correct_choices: Actions 1-13 were verified and made direct progress; no immediate switch reversal occurred.
The corrected Dustox handoff used Birdlaw attacks, a forced Ohmnomnom entry, and Spark rather than Croakatoa switch stalling.
Lildozer and Birdlaw fainted only after executing matchup damage; these were progress-making sacrifices, not passive switch targets.
agent_review.next_test: Qualification remains zero. Run clone 1 with the new behavior hash; no live fight is permitted.
